name: Elf o Karu Mono-tachi
original_name: エルフを狩るモノたち
source:
The story begins in a fantasy world, where three people – Airi, Ritsuko and Junpei – have been mysteriously teleported to (along with a type 74 tank). Since their presence could cause chaos in their world, the Elves decided to send them back. The ceremony is performed by the Elves' slightly psychotic leader, Celsia Marie Claire. The ceremony goes well, up until the very end when Junpei's unflattering comments push Celsia over the edge. She loses her focus and the incantation vanishes, separated in fragments, which the gang will have to find if they want to go back to their world. The only problem is that the fragments are etched on the skin of Elves, who may not want to submit to the scrutiny of our friends.

[From Anidb]
translation:
故事开始于一个奇幻世界。爱理、律子与淳平三人，连同一辆74式坦克，不知为何被传送到了这里。由于他们的存在可能给这个世界带来混乱，精灵们决定送他们回去。仪式由精灵中有些神经质的领袖雪露西亚·玛丽·克莱尔主持。起初一切顺利，可到了最后关头，淳平不客气的发言终于让雪露西亚忍无可忍。她分了心，咒文也随之消散，化成碎片。想回到原来的世界，一行人就必须找到这些碎片。唯一的问题是，碎片刻在精灵们的皮肤上，而她们可未必愿意任由这群朋友仔细查看。

[译自Anidb]
